title: Forward Deployed Engineering: The Complete Course
tagline: Discovery, messy data, integrations, LLM systems built with Claude, and production support — the full FDE playbook, taught through hands-on Python exercises you complete right in your browser.

modules.title: The FDE Role & Mindset
modules.summary: What forward deployed engineers actually do, how the role differs from SWE, solutions engineering and consulting, and the operating loop you'll run on every engagement.
outcomes: Explain the FDE role and where it fits in a company
Run the discover → build → deploy → measure → feed back loop
Prioritize a messy customer backlog with a defensible scoring model
Make your first Claude API call with the Anthropic Python SDK

modules.title: Customer Discovery & Scoping
modules.summary: Turn vague asks into scoped, measurable engagements: discovery calls, stakeholder maps, honest baselines, requirements extracted with Claude, and change requests handled without saying no.
outcomes: Run a discovery call that surfaces workflow, pain, and cost
Map stakeholders and act on the risks that kill engagements
Measure an honest baseline and write complete success metrics
Extract typed requirements with Claude structured outputs
Evaluate change requests and present trade-offs to a sponsor
plannedLessons: Discovery calls that uncover the real problem
Stakeholder mapping: champions, blockers, and budget holders
Exercise: Parse discovery notes into requirements
Exercise: Structured requirements extraction with Claude
Scope, change requests, and saying no

modules.title: Wrangling Messy Customer Data
modules.summary: Customer data is never clean. Profile it, normalize it, reconcile systems of record, deduplicate entities, label free text with Claude cost-effectively, and report quality so problems get fixed at the source.
outcomes: Profile an unfamiliar dataset in your first hour
Normalize dates, money, phones and IDs without guessing
Reconcile two systems and catch the join bug that doubles revenue
Find duplicate companies and choose thresholds deliberately
Label thousands of records with Claude: rules first, batched, with cost estimates
Produce a data-quality report a customer can act on
plannedLessons: Data profiling: your first hour with customer data
Normalization: dates, money, phone numbers, IDs
Exercise: Clean a messy orders file
Exercise: Reconcile two systems of record

modules.title: APIs & Integrations
modules.summary: Connect to customer systems that paginate, rate-limit, time out and change without warning. Build clients, webhook receivers and sync jobs that survive production, and use Claude to speed up integration work safely.
outcomes: Call REST APIs with auth, sessions, timeouts and full pagination
Retry the right failures with backoff and respect rate limits
Verify webhook signatures and process duplicate or out-of-order events correctly
Build idempotent incremental sync jobs with watermarks and schema mapping
Use Claude to propose schema mappings, validated and human-reviewed
plannedLessons: REST in the real world: auth, pagination, errors

modules.title: SQL & Data Modeling on Customer Systems
modules.summary: Query customer databases safely and fluently: answer executive questions, use window functions and cohorts, build a metrics layer, guard production data, and put Claude-powered text-to-SQL behind real guardrails.
outcomes: Answer executive questions with joins, HAVING and anti-joins
Use window functions for dedup, growth and cohort retention
Build a metrics layer of SQL views without double counting
Access production data safely: read-only, parameters, row limits, PII masking
Ship a text-to-SQL assistant with Claude that refuses unsafe queries
plannedLessons: SQL refresher for FDEs (sqlite3 in Python)
Exercise: Answer the exec's question with SQL
Data modeling for analytics and AI

modules.title: Building with Claude: Anthropic SDK Fundamentals
modules.summary: The core of modern FDE work. Messages, system prompts, multi-turn state, structured outputs, streaming, errors, cost and model choice.
outcomes: Use the Anthropic Python SDK fluently
Write system prompts that hold up on real customer data
Get reliable JSON with structured outputs
Handle errors, retries, refusals, tokens and cost
plannedLessons: Prompting for production: system prompts and examples
Errors, retries, refusals, tokens and cost

modules.title: Tool Use, RAG & Agents
modules.summary: Give Claude access to customer systems. Define tools, write the agent loop, retrieve from documents, and know when not to build an agent.
outcomes: Define tools with JSON schemas and strict mode
Write and debug the tool-use loop
Build retrieval-augmented generation over customer docs
Choose between a single call, a workflow and an agent
plannedLessons: Tool use: how Claude calls your code
Exercise: A CRM agent with three tools
Exercise: RAG over a customer knowledge base
Workflows vs agents: picking the simplest thing

modules.title: Evals, Reliability & Cost
modules.summary: Prove your LLM system works before the customer finds out it doesn't. Build eval sets, graders, regression gates and cost models.
outcomes: Build an eval set from real customer examples
Write code-based and LLM-as-judge graders
Gate releases on eval regressions
Model and reduce cost with caching and effort
plannedLessons: Why evals are the FDE's superpower
Cost modeling, prompt caching and effort
Exercise: Cost calculator for a deployment

modules.title: Shipping to Production
modules.summary: Deploy into environments you don't control. Config, secrets, logging, observability, incident response and the post-mortem.
outcomes: Package and configure a service for a customer environment
Add structured logging and metrics
Debug a production incident from logs alone
Write a blameless post-mortem and a handoff runbook
plannedLessons: Exercise: Debug an incident from logs

modules.title: Capstone: An End-to-End Engagement
modules.summary: Run a full simulated engagement for a fictional logistics customer: discovery notes to scoped brief, data cleanup, integration, a Claude-powered triage agent with evals, and the executive readout.
outcomes: Scope an engagement from raw discovery notes
Clean and integrate the customer's data
Ship a Claude-powered agent with an eval suite
Present results to an executive sponsor
plannedLessons: Exercise: Clean and join their shipment data
